rows.concern: Protected custom credentials, full redirect chains and explicit trust
rows.limits: 301/302/303/307/308 and two-hop chains; native Fetch owns redirect rewriting/Authorization stripping.

rows.concern: Conditional/range reads and writes preserve actual HTTP semantics
rows.limits: 24 warm/reverse/presence cases assert received fields,206/304/412/200 and exact bytes; cache is not an RFC revalidation engine.

rows.concern: Final body bytes, explicit versus inferred MIME and native multipart boundaries
rows.limits: 64 pair transitions plus derived POST/PUT/native controls and explicit MIME; arbitrary chain length is not exhaustive.

rows.concern: Relative/absolute/base/root/query/trailing separator fidelity
rows.limits: Finite examples; not every interleaving.

rows.concern: Sibling AvirxError cancellation belongs to current operation
rows.limits: Observable stages and barriers; native Response body errors retain platform ownership.

rows.concern: Strict unknown-property rejection and generic builder assignability
rows.limits: Strict DOM NodeNext consumers, noUncheckedIndexedAccess=false;25 negative assertions plus generic helpers.

rows.concern: Reserved then rejects without Promise assimilation or transport
rows.limits: Finite examples; not every interleaving.

rows.concern: Own symbol contract keys reject instead of disappearing
rows.limits: Finite examples; not every interleaving.

rows.concern: Unsafe placeholder names cannot hide a second dot segment
rows.limits: Finite examples; not every interleaving.

rows.concern: Elapsed cache/rate/duration clocks differ from wall-clock dates
rows.limits: Forward/back wall shifts and bounded Retry-After seconds/date/clamp metadata with abort; no 60-second sleep or host suspend proof.

rows.concern: URL userinfo rejects before transport and diagnostic leakage
rows.limits: Finite examples; not every interleaving.

rows.concern: Awaited path schema outputs match exact runtime keys
rows.limits: Finite examples; not every interleaving.

rows.concern: Stable operation error kinds and current request metadata
rows.limits: Finite examples; not every interleaving.

rows.concern: Callback ownership is consistent across phases and terminals
rows.limits: 60sibling-error combinations plus sync/async and abortedcallback controls; callback code must itself settle.

rows.concern: Clear prevents older eligible operations from refilling cache
rows.limits: Auth-policy operations are cache-ineligible and are only privacy/progress controls, not generation proof.

rows.concern: Supported public snapshots and advanced live handles
rows.limits: Caller releases each directly acquired concurrency slot exactly once; misuse is outside promise.

rows.concern: Timeout/concurrency end at headers and body ownership remains native
rows.limits: No global operation/memory bound; caller-owned raw/error bodies need consume/cancel; callbacks must settle.

rows.concern: CORS-hidden Vary cannot defeat cache privacy
rows.limits: Finite examples; not every interleaving.

rows.concern: Absent and empty headers differ; cURL literal at-sign stays inline

rows.concern: Mutable inspection values cannot rewrite other executions

rows.concern: Abandoned retry/hook-failed endless bodies close

rows.concern: Rate follows hooks/concurrency and cancelled queues release ownership

rows.concern: Finite cache entry/body budgets and expiry

rows.concern: Actual consumer refresh/upload/stream/mutation interactions
